user.title: Set up Quartermaster
user.description: Quartermaster keeps track of your pantry, fridge, freezer and shelves and builds your shopping list. Everything set here can be changed later in the options. The dashboard is a separate download: install Quartermaster Dashboard from the Marketplace, then add it from Settings → Dashboards.

data_description.name: Shown as the integration name and in front of entity names, for example "Quartermaster Shopping list".
data_description.language: Language of notifications, Telegram messages and replies sent by Quartermaster itself.

data.structure_mode: How to ask for the item list

data_description.agent_id: Agent used by quartermaster.ask (Alexa, Telegram, dashboard). Attach the Assist API to it so it can use the Quartermaster tools.
data_description.ai_task_image: AI Task entity with a vision model that analyzes zone photos and camera frames.
data_description.structure_mode: Use the fallback if your provider handles nested structures badly.
data_description.confidence_threshold: In automatic mode, recognized changes at or above this confidence are applied; the others are proposed. A zone can override it.
data_description.daily_analysis_limit: Model calls for images stop for the day after this many.
data_description.ai_task_text: Optional AI Task entity for text-only work, such as reading order emails. Empty uses the one for images.
data_description.hourly_analysis_limit: Model calls for images and receipts wait for the next hour after this many.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Where you keep food and supplies. Remove the ones you don't have, rename them or type new ones. You can add more later.

data_description.zones: Each zone gets its own last check sensor and check button.

zone.title: Zone {zone}
zone.description: Optional: a camera that sees {zone}. And how to check {zone} when there is no camera, or it cannot see clearly: with a photo you send, or by going through its list on Telegram or by voice. The list suits places a photo shows badly, such as a closed cupboard, the fridge or the freezer.

data_description.roi: The part of the frame to analyze, as fractions x1, y1, x2, y2 (for example 0.6, 0.05, 1, 1). Empty uses the whole frame.
data_description.check: With the list, Quartermaster never asks for photos of this zone: every 30 days (you can change it) it sends you what should be there, oldest first, and you tap what changed.

channels.title: Telegram and voice
channels.description: All optional. You can set up Telegram later.

data_description.telegram_event_entity: The update event entity of your Telegram bot (Polling or Webhooks). Leave empty to turn the Telegram channel off.
data_description.telegram_bot_entry: The bot used for replies; taken from the events when empty.
data_description.telegram_chats: Chat IDs Quartermaster answers, in addition to the bot's own allowlist. Group IDs are negative.
data_description.telegram_groups: Group messages are ignored unless this is on.
data_description.ask_session_seconds: How long an answer continues the same conversation, for example after a question.
data_description.alexa_read_only: Requests from Alexa cannot change the inventory or the list.

data.telegram_notify: Also notify Telegram chats, with buttons

data_description.notify_photo_request: Notify entities in order: the first available one is used.
data_description.quiet_hours: For example 22:00-07:00; messages wait until the end.
data_description.telegram_notify: Sends every notification to the allowed private Telegram chats, with buttons. Do not also select the Telegram notify entities.

essentials.title: Essentials
essentials.description: Products that must always be at home: when they run out they go on the shopping list. You can also import the items of a todo list you already use.

data_description.essentials: One product per line, for example coffee or milk. Each starts with a minimum of 1.
data_description.import_todo: For example your Bring! or local shopping list. Its items are read once, at setup.
data_description.import_target: Products, essentials, or items of the Quartermaster shopping list.

error.invalid_roi: Enter four fractions between 0 and 1, x1, y1, x2, y2, with x1 < x2 and y1 < y2.
error.invalid_quiet_hours: Enter the quiet hours as HH:MM-HH:MM, for example 22:00-07:00.

ambiguous_zone.message: {zone} matches more than one zone: {candidates}. Say which one.

ambiguous_product.message: {product} matches more than one product: {candidates}. Say which one.

not_in_stock.message: {product} is not in stock in any zone.

min_stock_required.message: An essential product needs a minimum stock: {product}.

target_below_min.message: The target stock of {product} is below its minimum stock.

nothing_to_undo.message: There is no movement to undo.

undo_zone_missing.message: The movement cannot be undone because its zone was deleted.

import_unreadable.message: The file {filename} cannot be read from the quartermaster/exports folder.

invalid_filename.message: {filename} is not a valid file name. Give only the name of a file in the quartermaster/exports folder.

database_too_new.message: The inventory database was written by a newer version of Quartermaster (schema {found}). Update the integration.

database_error.message: The inventory database cannot be opened: {error}

product_in_many_zones.message: {product} is in more than one zone: {candidates}. Say which one.

todo_unreadable.message: The items of {entity} cannot be read.

ai_task_missing.message: Choose an AI Task entity for images in the Quartermaster options.

daily_limit.message: The daily limit of {limit} image analyses is reached.

media_dir_missing.message: Home Assistant has no local media folder to pass the image to AI Task.

path_not_allowed.message: {path} is not in a folder Home Assistant may read (allowlist_external_dirs).

camera_unavailable.message: The camera image cannot be read: {error}

invalid_schedule.message: {schedule} is not a valid five-field cron schedule.

telegram_download_failed.message: The photo could not be downloaded from Telegram: {error}

hourly_limit.message: The limit of {limit} image analyses per hour is reached.

options.list: Go through the list with me

adjust_stock.name: Adjust stock
adjust_stock.description: Records that a product was consumed, bought or finished in a zone.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: Consume removes the quantity, purchase adds it, finish sets the zone to zero.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Quantity in the product's unit. Defaults to 1; ignored when finishing.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Zone name, alias or ID. If omitted, the zone is chosen from where the product is kept.

best_before.name: Best before
best_before.description: Best-before date of the stock in this zone.

add_zone.name: Add zone
add_zone.description: Creates a zone where products are kept, such as the fridge or a shelf.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

name.name: Name
name.description: Zone name, unique in the inventory.

aliases.name: Aliases
aliases.description: Other names the zone is called by.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Optional ID (lowercase letters, digits and underscores). Derived from the name if omitted.

remove_zone.name: Remove zone
remove_zone.description: Deletes a zone that holds no products. Its movements stay in the journal.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

undo_last.name: Undo last operation
undo_last.description: Reverts the most recent operation that is not undone yet. An operation can change several products.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

operation_id.name: Operation
operation_id.description: ID of the operation to undo (from the journal); the newest one when omitted.

set_stock.name: Set stock
set_stock.description: Sets the counted quantity of a product in a zone.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Counted quantity in the product's unit.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Zone name, alias or ID. If omitted, the zone is chosen from where the product is kept.

best_before.name: Best before
best_before.description: Best-before date of the stock in this zone.

add_product.name: Add product
add_product.description: Creates a product in the inventory.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

name.name: Name
name.description: Product name, unique in the inventory.

aliases.name: Aliases
aliases.description: Other names the product is called by.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category, for example cheese or pasta.

default_zone.name: Default zone
default_zone.description: Zone where purchases go when no zone is given.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the quantities, for example bottle or pack.

essential.name: Essential
essential.description: The product must always be at home.

min_stock.name: Minimum stock
min_stock.description: Below this total quantity the product goes on the shopping list. Required for essentials.

target_stock.name: Target stock
target_stock.description: Quantity to bring the product back to when buying.

visual_hints.name: Visual hints
visual_hints.description: How the product looks, to help recognize it in photos.

set_essential.name: Set essential
set_essential.description: Marks a product as essential with its stock levels, or unmarks it.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

essential.name: Essential
essential.description: Turn off to remove the product from the essentials.

min_stock.name: Minimum stock
min_stock.description: Below this total quantity the product goes on the shopping list. Required for essentials.

target_stock.name: Target stock
target_stock.description: Quantity to bring the product back to when buying.

export_data.name: Export data
export_data.description: Writes the inventory to a file in the quartermaster/exports folder of the configuration directory. JSON holds everything; CSV holds products and stock.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

import_data.name: Import data
import_data.description: Reads a file from the quartermaster/exports folder. A JSON export replaces the whole inventory; a CSV file adds missing zones and products and sets their quantities.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Name of the file in the quartermaster/exports folder.

get_suggestions.name: Get suggestions
get_suggestions.description: Returns the essentials to buy, the purchase suggestions with their reason and the open shopping list items.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

refresh_shopping_list.name: Refresh shopping list
refresh_shopping_list.description: Recomputes the essentials to buy and the suggestions and updates the shopping list.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

start_shopping.name: Go shopping
start_shopping.description: Refreshes the list and turns shopping mode on: checking an item off records the purchase.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Adds a product or free text to the shopping list. A product already on the list is not added twice.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

product.name: Product
product.description: Product name, alias or ID. Use this or text.

text.name: Text
text.description: Free text for something that is not a product. Use this or product.

from_suggestion.name: From a suggestion
from_suggestion.description: The item comes from an accepted suggestion.

import_from_todo.name: Import from todo list
import_from_todo.description: Reads another todo list and turns its items into products, essentials or shopping list items. Without apply it only returns a preview.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Carry out the import; otherwise only preview it.

ask.name: Ask
ask.description: Sends a sentence to the conversation agent with the Quartermaster tools and returns what to say, whether to keep listening and a short reprompt. Used by Alexa intent_script and other channels.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Where the request comes from; recorded in the journal.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the text; defaults to the system language.

session_key.name: Session key
session_key.description: Keeps separate threads, for example one per Echo device. Defaults to the user.

analyze_image.name: Analyze image
analyze_image.description: Analyzes a photo or a camera frame of a zone with the AI Task entity for images and proposes the changes (or applies them in automatic mode above the confidence threshold).

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

file.name: File
file.description: Path of an image in a folder Home Assistant may read. Use this or a camera.

camera_entity_id.name: Camera
camera_entity_id.description: Camera to take the frame from. Use this or a file.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Where the request comes from; recorded in the journal.

confirm_pending.name: Confirm proposal
confirm_pending.description: Confirms or rejects a proposal of changes recognized from an image.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

items.name: Items
items.description: Keys of the items to confirm; all when omitted.

corrections.name: Corrections
corrections.description: List of items to fix, each with key, product and quantity; the name the model used is learned as an alias.

set_zone.name: Set zone
set_zone.description: Changes a zone: name, aliases, sources in priority order, check schedule, reminders and confidence threshold.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

sources.name: Sources
sources.description: List of sources in priority order: camera, camera_show, passage, manual. See the documentation for their fields. Camera_show and passage frames show people: only the show area goes to the AI provider and frames are deleted right after the analysis. Enable them only if you accept that.

check_schedule.name: Check schedule
check_schedule.description: Cron schedule with five fields, for example 0 19 * * *; empty to remove.

reminder_days.name: Reminder days
reminder_days.description: Ask for a photo when a zone without camera is not updated for this many days; 0 to turn off.

confidence_threshold.name: Confidence threshold
confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence for this zone; 0 uses the general option.

check_zone.name: Check zone
check_zone.description: Checks a zone now with its sources: camera first, then a photo request.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Where the request comes from; photo requests go back there.

arm_show_mode.name: Arm show mode
arm_show_mode.description: Turns on show mode for a zone with camera_show: products shown to the camera are recorded. It turns itself off after the configured time.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to stay on; the source setting when omitted.

analyze_receipt.name: Analyze receipt
analyze_receipt.description: Reads a photo of a shop receipt with the AI Task entity for images and proposes the purchases, to confirm or correct.

config_entry_id.name: Quartermaster entry
config_entry_id.description: The Quartermaster config entry to act on. If omitted, the only one is used.

file.name: File
file.description: Path of the receipt photo in a folder Home Assistant may read.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Where the request comes from; recorded in the journal.

show_suspended.title: Show mode suspended in {zone}
